scope: same-process synchronous ReAct tool retry through the default AgentExecutor and Crew.kickoff; no task retry, worker replacement, checkpoint restore, or external re-trigger
failure: One injected RuntimeError inside an argument-free tool, on its first invocation only. The pre-effect arm raises before execute; the post-effect arm raises after the execute-only ledger acknowledges its append but before the tool returns to CrewAI.
identity: Harness assigns logical_action_id before creating the worker, LLM, agent, or tool. A distinct attempt_id is allocated at every actual tool entry. The ledger receives key=null and identical harmless payloads, so duplicate action IDs remain admissible.
pre_effect_interpretation: The failed attempt commits zero effects. CrewAI's tool retry performs the first valid effect; final count is therefore predicted to be one, not zero.
plan: One diagnostic invocation with one trial per case. After verifying injection and oracle, one bounded sample of 30 trials per case. Preserve distributions and any failed diagnostic; never revise this prediction after a run.
missing_evidence_rule: An unavailable oracle or incomplete evidence has effect_count=null, no PASS, and VOID or UNVERIFIED classification.
limits: No real LLM or provider; no idempotency guard; no fresh-process recovery measurement; local ledger survives worker errors, but host power-loss durability is not tested. Current CrewAI separately supports optional checkpoint restore; this experiment does not measure it.
